entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yevgeni Ivanovich Alekseyev or Alexeyev was a Russian admiral in the Imperial Russian Navy, viceroy of the Russian Far East, and commander-in-chief of Imperial Russian forces at Port Arthur and in Manchuria during the first year of the Russo-Japanese War of 1904–05.
